activity.notes: Margaret exercised governing power in Norway from 1380 during the reign of her son Olaf and was chosen regent for life after his death in 1388. ATLAS records the Norwegian pre-Kalmar phase through 1397 and leaves her later union-level rule in the existing Kalmar Union Activity.

sources.title: Margrete 1. — Lex
sources.citation_text: Lex states that Margaret exercised governing power in Norway from 1380 to 1412 and was chosen regent for life in Norway in early 1388.
